newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ROBSON'S DEPUTY HITS OUT AT BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROBSON'S DEPUTY HITS OUT AT BARCELONA.

text.p: Barcelona deputy coach Jose Mourinho on Wednesday hit out at the club for preparing to fire him and Bobby Robson while ignoring their successes this season.
"If the way they think is the same for everybody ... the next coach will be changed if he doesn't win the league," said Mourinho.
Mourinho emphasised that he and Robson had won the Spanish Super Cup, the European Cup Winners' Cup, a place in next season's European Cup and a slot in the Spanish Cup final on June 28.

His remarks followed the publication of Spanish sports press of comments attributed to Jose Luis Nunez, in which the Barcelona president said that Robson would not continue because he had not won the league.
But a Barcelona club official said on Wednesday Nunez had withdrawn the comments, and that the organisational structure for next season's coaching staff would be made public on July 1.
